players.product: on-premises superconducting quantum computers (five-qubit IQM Spark; IQM Radiance, approximately 20 to 150 qubits) and IQM Resonance cloud

quarterly_data.quarter: IQM Quantum Computers press release: Bechtle expands DLR quantum computing resources with IQM (10-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Under a new framework agreement, Bechtle (IQM's partner since 2024) is providing the German Aerospace Center's Quantum Computing Initiative (DLR QCI) with cloud-based computing time on IQM's superconducting quantum computers through the IQM Resonance platform until June 2027, plus a dedicated classical server at IQM's Munich data center for hybrid workloads; superconducting systems join the ion-trap, neutral-atom, photonic and NV-center systems the DLR QCI already uses.
